Emergency fund इमरजेंसी फ़ंड

Cash or very safe, liquid savings to cover 3 to 6 months of expenses. Keep it separate from investments.

हिंदी में: इमरजेंसी फ़ंड

3 से 6 महीने के खर्च के लिए नकद या बहुत सुरक्षित, तुरंत उपलब्ध बचत। इसे निवेश से अलग रखें।

How it is used in the lessons

An emergency fund stops you from selling investments at a bad time to pay for a surprise expense.

From Investing & Wealth Building

Build an emergency fund of about 3 to 6 months of expenses before you invest for growth.
